title: Telecommunications Infrastructure Standard for Data Centers
summary: Specifies minimum requirements for data center site design, cabling architectures, redundancy tiers (Rated-1 through Rated-4), and safety distances.

title: Data Center Site Infrastructure Tier Standard: Topology
summary: Defines Tier I through Tier IV availability criteria. Mandates Concurrent Maintainability (Tier III) and Fault Tolerance (Tier IV) without impacting live loads.

title: Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments
summary: Recommends dry-bulb temperature ranges (18°C to 27°C) and dew point ranges (5.5°C to 15°C) for server reliability and energy efficiency.
ndcStatus: Strictly monitored in BMS cold aisles

title: Standard for the Fire Protection of Information Technology Equipment
summary: NFPA 75 is the Standard for the Fire Protection of Information Technology Equipment, published by the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA). The standard outlines the minimum fire protection requirements to safeguard Information Technology Equipment (ITE), data centers, and computer rooms from fire, smoke, corrosion, heat, and water damage.
ndcStatus: Mandatory standard for all suppression systems

title: Standard on Clean Agent Fire Extinguishing Systems
summary: NFPA 2001 is the Standard on Clean Agent Fire Extinguishing Systems, a widely recognized code published by the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA). It provides comprehensive rules for the buying, designing, installing, testing, inspecting, approving, operating, and maintaining of gaseous fire suppression systems.
ndcStatus: Mandatory standard for all suppression systems

title: Bangladesh National Building Code (BNBC)
publisher: Ministry of Housing and Public Works, Bangladesh
summary: National statutory building compliance, seismic loading, substation room clearance, and earth pit impedance thresholds under 1 Ohm.
